g.text: Rebuilding a missing window cache: exact reconstruction versus bounded replay (W = 4, 3 layers)
Exact reconstruction: each layer's window needs the previous
layer's window over the W tokens before it
blue: tokens that must be recomputed = L x W (here 12; V4-Flash: 43 x 128 = 5,504).
Bounded replay: recompute only the last W tokens;
every layer's window truncates at the replay start
blue: W tokens recomputed. States at the boundary are approximate; the newest are near exact.
Trained under the same truncation in post-training.
